limitations: The control side holds six wallets, not twelve. After the switch back to the control Deriver A, two of three warm-up registrations failed with HTTP 503 from the Yao execution: Deriver B's wallet object took 14.6 s for one preparation, with 506 ms for one D1 read, and refused the pair as not prepared. Deriver B's version was the same in every group. The driver stopped and restored staging.
One candidate wallet took 7.6 s: 5.4 s for registration and 2.2 s for its signature.
The automated confirmation is shorter than one prepare exchange, so part of the prepare still follows it.
The registration metric includes setup. The hosted auth menu runs setup before the click; registrationAfterSetupMs is the wait after it.
